title: Backend → Data & AI → Technical Leadership
description: Expanded from core backend ownership into applied data/AI and technical leadership while continuing to contribute across production systems, MVP delivery, and R&D.

roles.title: Technical Lead
roles.description: Lead a 4-member cross-functional team delivering full-stack MVPs and R&D initiatives, oversee Data & AI engineering alongside backend work, and coordinate technical alignment, task distribution, and delivery.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Gather and analyze business data, build and deploy ML models, work with LLMs/VLMs through prompting and fine-tuning, and deploy data/ML solutions with AWS SageMaker and Lambda using Python and SQL.

roles.title: Back End Developer
roles.description: Core backend engineer across production products from MVP to live deployment. Built Go/Gin server-worker systems, TypeScript services, a B2C maritime job-matching platform, and B2B ERP systems covering crew, vessel, contracts, LMS, attendance, and payroll.

impacts: **Delivery:** 5 web ERP products + 2 mobile ERP applications for client companies; Clean Architecture, TDD, API versioning, database architecture, Redis caching, and Asynq background processing.
**Additional reported impact:** reduced production costs by 70% through LLM API integrations and improved team productivity through ML, data engineering, and workflow optimization.

title: Telecom provisioning & integration microservice
description: Built and maintained a Go microservice for ISP service provisioning, order management, and customer operations, acting as an integration layer between internal systems and external platforms. Designed a shared business layer serving REST and gRPC clients with Clean Architecture / Port & Adapter principles.
impacts: **Integration scope:** 10+ external APIs spanning payments, OIDC authentication, media/services, WhatsApp omnichannel, and telecom providers; event-driven processing with Kafka, Redis-backed OTP/token workflows, signed webhook verification, and TM Forum-aligned service APIs.

title: From LangGraph prototype to production Go AI service
description: Built an AI chatbot agent in Python with LangGraph, then migrated and reimplemented the solution in Go for production readiness. Delivered the AI solution end-to-end from experimentation through implementation and collaborated directly with client stakeholders.

title: Data visualization in financial operations
description: Supported DPLK operational work through data visualization and website review, adding financial-services exposure to an engineering and data-focused background.

title: Teaching foundations and NLP research
description: Served across programming, data structures, software testing, object-oriented programming, and NLP teaching roles. Guided classes in Go, Java, C++, Python/NLTK, Maven, Jira, and Katalon; also coordinated OOP practicum assistants before supporting an NLP course as an assistant lecturer.
impacts: **Leadership foundation:** coordinated practicum responsibilities and guided multiple classes before moving into professional engineering leadership.
